description:
Subject: Details for the **my_library** Drupal asset package (v 1.4.2)

Dear Team,

The **my_library** package is currently at version 1.4.2 and is hosted in the public repository at https://github.com/example/my_library. It is released under the MIT License (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) and is GPL‑compatible. The library does not need to be injected into the page header.

When the library is attached, the following Drupal settings are made available under `drupalSettings.myLibrary`: an API key of **abcd1234** and a boolean flag `enabled` set to **true**.

**JavaScript assets**  
- `js/script.js` – not minified, will be pre‑processed, carries a weight of 10, and is cache‑able.  
- `js/extra.min.js` – already minified, will not be pre‑processed, carries a weight of 20, is not cache‑able, and is served from the local site (not external).

**CSS assets**  
- **Base**: `css/style.css` – placed in SMACSS group 0, applies to all media types, will be pre‑processed, and has a weight of 5.  
- **Layout**: `css/layout.css` – placed in SMACSS group 1, targeted at the **screen** media, will be pre‑processed, and has a weight of 10.  
- **Component**: `css/buttons.css` – placed in SMACSS group 2, applies to all media types, will **not** be pre‑processed, and has a weight of 15.

**Dependencies**  
The library requires the core Drupal assets `core/jquery` and `core/drupal` to be loaded beforehand.

Please let me know if any further configuration is needed.
